sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can describe the weather in detail — sun, wind, clouds, rain and snow.
I can talk about the four seasons and their special time-forms.
I can compare temperatures and describe how hot or cold it is.
I can make weather-based plans and say what I need for the weather.
